similarSpecies.distinction: Substantive identification/range/conservation read. Adult Eurasian/Common Moorhen Gallinula chloropus,30–38cm dark blackish-brown upperparts greyish underparts, WHITE upper-flank line and WHITE undertail often displayed during tail flicking. RED frontal shield and bill base YELLOW tip, yellow legs long unlobed toes. Juveniles dull brown, paler belly/white throat, grey legs and greenish/grey shield not adult features. Nominate Europe/N Africa/WCSAsia to China/HK; other subspecies C/S Africa/Indian Ocean islands/Malay archipelago/Indonesia/Philippines. China S resident NNW/NE summer visitor. LC stable globally despite HK local decline. Omnivorous swimming/walking vegetated wetlands.

Substantive identification/range/conservation read. Adult36–39cm compact broad dark body, white bill/frontal shield and red iris, huge lobed toes yellow legs. Pale trailing secondary edge flight-only not demonstrated. First-winter olivebrown tinged upperparts and white-tipped throat/cheek/underparts different. Europe/Asia south Arctic, northerly populations winter N Africa/S China/SE Asia; residents Java/Bali/NewGuinea/Australasia, nominate Europe/NAfrica to India/Japan/SEAsia/Philippines/Borneo. LC increasing globally despite sharp HK winter declines.

rangeMap.note: Breeding adult MALE representative41–43cm, charcoal grey upperparts subtle paler grey/brown feather fringes, blackish below, red extended frontal shield above YELLOW bill. Female31–36cm very different warm brown broad feather edges, pale plain head dark crown/hindneck, yellowish small shield/bill. Second-year male incomplete shield/browner edges. Monotypic Indian subcontinent/Indochina/China/Korea/Ussuriland south through SEAsia much Indonesia, northern populations migratory. HK scarce passage/rare summer and strongly declined former breeding lost. LC decreasing globally. Source summary says slightly more spring but occurrence says autumn; do not resolve contradictory seasonal emphasis without evidence.
